scientific_integrity: The claim is an analytic asymptotic limit; exact finite-state enumeration validates the transition kernel, not the asymptotic proof. Literature priority is a best-knowledge assessment and no external or independent mathematical audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to synchronous closed-neighborhood probabilistic zero forcing from the unique hub of the friendship graph K_1 join (m K_2) as m tends to infinity, not optimized starting vertices, other forcing variants, or centered fluctuation distributions.
title: Sharp logarithmic propagation constant for probabilistic zero forcing on friendship graphs
